Begin Your Path To A Career With A Purpose
At the University of Michigan-Dearborn, you’ll have more than 200 options for majors, minors, graduate programs and certificates to pursue.
Whatever path you choose, you will gain real-world experience through practice-based learning, along with meaningful research, internship and co-op opportunities. At UM-Dearborn, you aren’t just launching a career-you’re launching a career to make a difference personally and professionally.
